description: JVM Maven Central Registry Submission: discover, prepare, submit, and evidence Maven Central publication for io.github.edithatogo:mchs.
blocker: Minimal JVM module, Maven publishing metadata, credential-safe Central Portal repository wiring, and in-memory signing wiring are checked in. GitHub Actions Maven Central dry-run passes. A 2026-06-13T04:41:31Z credential audit found no relevant local CENTRAL, MAVEN, GPG, or SIGNING environment variable names and GitHub repository secrets show NUGET_API_KEY and OVSX_PAT only; required Maven Central secrets CENTRAL_PORTAL_DEPLOY_URL, CENTRAL_PORTAL_USERNAME, CENTRAL_PORTAL_PASSWORD, MAVEN_SIGNING_KEY, and MAVEN_SIGNING_PASSWORD are not configured. Namespace verification, signing key material, authenticated Central Portal release, and public Maven Central verification remain pending.
